{{Top|leg}}
An '''Orb-spider''' was an arachnid creature that could be found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] would periodically take [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|younglings]] to the [[Jedi Temple meditation gardens|garden]] and watch orb-spiders weave their web.<ref name="DR">''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]''</ref>
